doc: Per-square owner acceptances. Each entry forgives only the named veto keys on the named square, and only while the status file carries a matching owner_accept block bound to the live picture's SHA. gate_check.VETO_TABLE and VETO_TABLE_SHA256 are NOT changed, no reviewer's answer or note is rewritten, and no other square is affected. See handoff/opus-74-decisions-2026-11-03.md.
ruling: Owner delegated the 74 escalated squares to Opus 5.5 on 2026-11-03, on the standard he set on 2026-10-30: the Bible governs, and a veto applied against the passage's own account or against the period it actually happened in is the veto that is wrong. Nothing is accepted that depicts God the Father or Christ in a forbidden way, any Trinity composition, or anything that would mislead about Scripture.
